insights.title: Insights
insights.runTitle: Look for places, spawns, classes and players that stand out from the map's own baseline. Counted in the background over every match loaded, with the filters applied.
insights.stale: The filters or the data changed since this was counted.
insights.summary: {n} findings from {rows} rows in {matches} matches, strongest first
insights.none: Nothing stands out at a false discovery rate of {fdr}.
insights.showTitle: Show it: the camera on the place, the filters that isolate it
insights.resetTitle: Put back the filters from before the first insight was shown
insights.copyTitle: Copy the whole report as JSON: every number, place and filter, to keep or to hand to another tool
insights.volumeTitle: Draw a volume round this place, for its full statistics and comparisons
insights.skip.noEvents: no event types in the data
insights.skip.noTime: no time spent to measure against
insights.say.power.kd: Power position: {kills} kills for {deaths} deaths here, {ratio}× the kill-to-death odds of the rest of the map
insights.say.power.safe: Safe ground: {deaths} deaths in {timeSecs} spent here, {ratio}× fewer per time than elsewhere
insights.say.zones.hot: {kind} hot zone: {count} where {expected} were expected for the time spent here ({ratio}×)
insights.say.zones.cold: {kind} quiet zone: {count} where {expected} were expected for the time spent here ({ratio}× fewer)
insights.say.cover.open: Open ground is deadlier: {ratio}× the deaths per time in the most open third of the ground as among the densest level geometry
insights.say.cover.dense: Cover does not protect here: {ratio}× the deaths per time among the densest level geometry as in the open
insights.say.cover.slow: Standing still is deadly: {ratio}× the deaths per time below {slowBelow} units/s as above {fastAbove} units/s
insights.say.cover.fast: Speed is deadly: {ratio}× the deaths per time above {fastAbove} units/s as below {slowBelow} units/s
insights.say.spawn.strong: Strong spawn for {team}: {ratio}× the kills of the other spawns in the first {earlySecs}; first contact after {contactSecs} (median)
insights.say.spawn.trap: Spawn trap for {team}: {earlyPct} of {spawns} spawns die within {earlySecs}, {ratio}× the other spawns
insights.say.spawn.safe: Safe spawn for {team}: {earlyPct} of {spawns} spawns die within {earlySecs}, {ratio}× fewer than at the other spawns
insights.say.classPlace.strong: {class} dominate here: {kills} kills for {deaths} deaths, {ratio}× their kill-to-death odds elsewhere
insights.say.classPlace.weak: {class} struggle here: {kills} kills for {deaths} deaths, {ratio}× worse kill-to-death odds than elsewhere
insights.say.classPlace.actorStrong: {actor} dominate here: {kills} kills for {deaths} deaths, {ratio}× their kill-to-death odds elsewhere
insights.say.classPlace.actorWeak: {actor} struggle here: {kills} kills for {deaths} deaths, {ratio}× worse kill-to-death odds than elsewhere
insights.say.players.over: {player} kills {ratio}× as often per time as comparable players ({kills} kills in {timeSecs})
insights.say.players.under: {player} kills {ratio}× less often per time than comparable players ({kills} kills in {timeSecs})
insights.say.players.fragile: {player} dies {ratio}× as often per time as comparable players ({deaths} deaths in {timeSecs})
insights.say.players.durable: {player} dies {ratio}× less often per time than comparable players ({deaths} deaths in {timeSecs})
insights.say.flow.choke: Choke point: {crossings} crossings, {ratio}× the ground around it; {deaths} deaths here
insights.say.flow.flank: Flank route: crossing here leads to {ratio}× the kills within {approachSecs} of other ways, yet only {sharePct} of crossings use it
insights.say.outcome.opening: {team} won {withPct} of the {n1} rounds it took the opening duel, against {withoutPct} of {n2} when it lost it ({diff} points, 95% {lo} to {hi})
insights.say.outcome.buy: With the better buy {team} won {withPct} of {n1} rounds, against {withoutPct} of {n2} with the worse ({diff} points, 95% {lo} to {hi})
insights.say.outcome.traded: {team} won {withPct} of the {n1} rounds where its first death was traded, against {withoutPct} of {n2} where it was not ({diff} points, 95% {lo} to {hi})
insights.say.outcome.plant: {team} won {withPct} of the {n1} rounds it planted, against {withoutPct} of {n2} without a plant ({diff} points, 95% {lo} to {hi})
insights.say.outcome.utility: {team} won {withPct} of the {n1} rounds it used more utility than usual, against {withoutPct} of {n2} with less ({diff} points, 95% {lo} to {hi})
insights.say.outcome.fast: {team} won {withPct} of the {n1} rounds with the first contact before {fastSecs}, against {withoutPct} of {n2} with a later one ({diff} points, 95% {lo} to {hi})
insights.say.outcome.held: {team} won {withPct} of the {n1} rounds it held {place}, against {withoutPct} of {n2} without it ({diff} points, 95% {lo} to {hi})
insights.say.outcome.early: {team} won {withPct} of the {n1} rounds it reached {place} in the first 25 s, against {withoutPct} of {n2} otherwise ({diff} points, 95% {lo} to {hi})
insights.say.outcome.playerUp: {player} ({team}) added {wpa} rounds' worth of win probability over {rounds} rounds ({perRound} points a round, 95% {lo} to {hi})
insights.say.outcome.playerDown: {player} ({team}) cost {wpa} rounds' worth of win probability over {rounds} rounds ({perRound} points a round, 95% {lo} to {hi})
